title: SENSTACK OS Agent Manifest
description: Canonical format for defining every AI (and human) employee inside a SENSTACK OS building. One manifest file drives the HQ page, the Chief of Staff dispatcher, and — once each agent has an `instructions` block — real API calls to run that agent.

manifest_version.description: Semver of the manifest format itself, not the org. Bump when the schema shape changes.

examples: Build the Business. AI Runs the System.

brand.description: Optional theming hints so a renderer can stay on-brand without hardcoding colors.

founder.description: The one human seat. Rendered like an agent card but never assignable/dispatchable.

id.description: Slug used as the HTML anchor / directory link target.

floor.description: Display label for the building directory.

note.description: One-line mission for the whole department, shown under the floor heading.

agent.description: One AI employee. Everything a renderer needs for the card UI, plus everything an orchestrator needs to actually run this agent against the Anthropic API.

id.description: Stable unique slug, e.g. 'copywriter'. Never reuse across agents even if one is retired.

emoji.description: Fallback glyph shown if no photo avatar is set.

title.description: Short role label shown under the name (e.g. 'Roadmap Owner').

role.description: One-sentence statement of what this agent owns. Distinct from `title` (a label) — this is a sentence.

mission.description: Why this seat exists / what 'winning' looks like for this agent. 1-2 sentences.

status.description: online/busy = actively staffed and doing something right now. waiting = staffed, idle, ready for a task. recruiting = seat defined but not yet built/turned on.

status_label.description: Optional override for the status pill text (e.g. 'In the building' for the human founder).

current_task.description: What this agent is working on right now. Null/omitted when idle.

photo.description: Filename resolved against the org's photo base URL.

specs.description: Chip tags shown on the card (capabilities/keywords).

instructions.description: The full system prompt for this agent. This is the field that turns 'Copy prompt' into an actual API-callable agent — drop verbatim into messages/system when calling the model.

knowledge_base.description: References to SENSTACK OS modules, docs, or data sources this agent should be grounded in (e.g. module names, Drive doc titles, or manifest ids of other agents it depends on).

tasks.description: Concrete task types this agent is expected to handle. Used by the Chief of Staff dispatcher to match a goal to the right agent.

output.description: Example of what this agent would produce.

model.description: Which model this agent should run on. Lets you put a cheaper/faster model on simple roles and a stronger one on strategic roles.

tools.description: Tool names this agent is allowed to use if invoked through the API (e.g. 'web_search', an MCP server name).

human.description: True only for the founder seat. Human agents are never dispatchable/assignable.
